base: black gesso graduated to clear, thin alizarin crimson and phthalo blue wash

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: criss-cross light area in the center
steps.rule: starting in the center makes it darken outward

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: brighten the center with fresh white
steps.rule: a dirty brush would dull the center so clean it between loads

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: brush lightly across and blend the sky

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap lavender background trees
steps.load: lavender mix with more crimson than blue

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap warm highlights on the background bush
steps.load: a touch of each warm color
steps.rule: warm bright colors make the background bright

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap hot pink and blue shades into bushes
steps.load: pink mix then a touch of blue
steps.rule: cool next to warm makes a striking contrast

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap light sap green into the bushes
steps.rule: dark green would change the mood so keep it light
steps.new: some background left unpainted for depth

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint thin twigs and trunks with the liner

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap yellow greens for grassy ridges
steps.load: lavender on the brush then yellow
steps.motion: tap and push to build a ridge

steps.subject: land
steps.action: darken the land toward the back
steps.motion: tap with less pressure going back

steps.subject: other: light highlight
steps.action: pick out sparkle spots with white
steps.rule: light hitting one spot makes the painting sparkle

steps.subject: stream
steps.action: paint a thin stream with the fan
steps.load: liquid white with white and a touch of phthalo blue
steps.rule: liquid white thins paint so it slides over thick paint

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: block in a dark tree on the right of the falls
steps.rule: the dark is there only so light can go on top

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: block in bluish-gray light on the tree

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: dab foliage clusters with the corner in layers
steps.load: more yellow ochre on the brush
steps.rule: think about the tree shape so it does not look random

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: add a small grassy bank under the tree

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: paint stones with the filbert in one stroke
steps.load: thin brown mix with dark and light sides
steps.motion: touch and pull one side through the light

steps.subject: waterfall
steps.action: paint the waterfall around the stones
steps.load: thin white with a touch of phthalo blue
steps.motion: wiggle down and push upward for foam

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap a grassy bush with ochre and red
steps.load: grass green with a touch of red

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap a bush hanging over the water
steps.rule: makes the bush look like it sticks out over the water

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint a big tree trunk with bends using the liner
steps.motion: draw trunk with bends and wiggles
steps.rule: a liner makes many bends and wiggles easy

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint a second trunk running off the canvas

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add short arms to the trees

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: highlight the trunks with a filbert stroke
steps.load: thin rock color on the filbert

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add a few floating leaves at the top
steps.rule: keeps it sparse so the background still shows

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: shift the other side toward gold

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: brighten the big tree with red and ochre
steps.load: bright red added to yellow ochre

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint a few twigs on the lower limb
steps.load: a little of the light color

steps.subject: other: signature
steps.action: sign the painting
